open_findings.expected: The committed suites make it self-evident that the probe discriminates: under the probe, a VAULT-mode read of the same consumer returns no prospects while the Postgres-mode read returns the live set. Also, the focused controlled-run results are attached to the published round.
open_findings.minimal_repair: In the three allowed files only: (1) in source-flip test 2 and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (or one consumer test), add an in-suite control that, with the probe path active, sets ASCEND_PROSPECT_SOURCE='vault' for one read and asserts that prospect discovery returns 0 (e.g. listProspects() is empty and the knowledge-index prospect registry is empty), while the Postgres-mode read under the same probe still equals the baseline. Restore the source setting in finally. (2) Commit with a message body recording the focused controlled run of the three suites: exact per-suite passed/failed/skipped counts, the control result, confirmation that no tracked file changed (git status empty), and the read-only applogin/scratch-schema cleanup check. No URLs, values or secrets. Then freeze r2.
open_findings.observed: The current-source proof now rests entirely on the empty-vault probe: in source-flip test 2 (slugs listed with the vault path emptied equal a baseline read) and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (each consumer's output with only '02 - Sales & Hit List' emptied equals the current output). No code in these files, and no published evidence (one-line commit message; the manifest records only typecheck; no report on disk), shows that the probe catches the defect it exists for: a consumer still discovering prospects from the vault. If the probe did not actually remove vault prospect discovery (a wrong directory name, a symlinked prospect dir, or a reader that ignores ASCEND_VAULT_PATH), every comparison would pass vacuously. CURRENT-SOURCE-AND-CONTROLS requires demonstrating at least one control going red for the intended defect, and FOCUSED-CONTROLLED-PROOF requires exact focused results and a post-run clean tree. Neither can be verified from the published object.

regression_proof.description: The new in-suite control passes in the focused controlled run, and would fail if the probe left vault prospect discovery intact. The r2 commit body records the three suites' exact counts and a clean post-run tree.

required_manual_checks.description: Remove the obsolete assertion that current production still consists of exactly the six historical 2E fixture rows. Preserve a discriminating, bounded historical six-row migration witness as historical evidence; do not silently turn current production/vault equality into a pass.

Separately prove current reads use Postgres and do not fall back to the vault. Preserve controls that make a real source regression and a real field/parity regression fail. Demonstrate at least one focused mutation or adversarial control going red for the intended defect. Do not normalize or overwrite either source to satisfy the comparison.

Account for the four raw field differences under the provenance limits in apps/os/docs/DB-PROOF-001.md. Treat expected post-flip drift as such without declaring either the frozen vault or current production automatically correct; do not assert that the two name edits are independently authorized when the diagnosis did not establish that.

Inspect the parity suite's write to tracked apps/os/docs/stage2e/consumer-parity.json on changed recorded content before executing it. Repair that side effect only within the three allowed test files so a passing focused run leaves the tracked worktree clean and does not invalidate gate-proof clean-tree/receipt rules. If this cannot safely be done within those paths, stop and report the exact dependency; do not widen scope or write the tracked artifact.

Run only the three named DB suites in the controlled proof environment and report exact test results, the adversarial control result, and a post-run clean-tree verification. Confirm no production writes. Do not run the full production DB gate unless the accepted task contract explicitly requires it, and do not claim a phase proof receipt from a focused run.

Change only the three allowed test files. Do not change application/runtime, Sales, authorization/session, migrations, gate runner, Coordinator, production or vault data, or 2A.2d. Do not start DB-RESIDUE-001 or DB-ISOLATION-001. Report implementation, evidence, exact results, limitations, and clean-tree status; freeze/publish the exact candidate for Claude review through Coordinator.
